_doctrine: R-023: the baseline contract. Deck 1 BEATS = what a PLAIN tutorial on this concept would minimally need (derived from the concept, not the inventory); each beat is a ROLE cast with one artifact (alts = understudies). Deck 2 VOLTAGE = the few pieces a plain tutorial would never include -- the critical script, the thinker with QFEP. Everything uncast is AT DEPTH.
_note: SEQUENCE CANDIDATE #24 (census 2026-07-07): the VARIATIONAL PRINCIPLE — form as the minimum of a functional. Answer to 'what principle does Ada NOT cover': the one MODE of form-generation with no chapter — form as what MINIMIZES. Instruments scattered everywhere (gradient descent in ML, free-energy F in QFEP, catenary + minimal-surface artifacts, softbody settling) but never named as a principle. Proposed spine position: after forces (dynamics) and before wavefunctions — forces move things, form-finding is where they come to REST. No sequence JSON or maps exist yet; this contract is the feasibility test.

beats.role: the question — why does matter take THIS shape?
the soap film — the minimal surface

voltage.why: D'Arcy Thompson — 'On Growth and Form': the shape emerged from physics, not design; a form is a FOSSIL of the forces that made it, and biology's beauty is the calculus of variations wearing flesh

Gaudi / Frei Otto / Eiffel — form-finding as architecture: hang the chain, invert it, and you have the arch that stands with the LEAST material; the building as a solved minimization, gravity as the co-designer

form from prestress — it holds its shape under a load that would collapse a pile of the same parts; stability as an invisible tension, the counter-intuitive proof that structure is a FIELD of forces, not a stack of stuff

the QFEP face and the dark-room return: the landscape has an ethics — a deep narrow well is a DEAD-perfect form, a shallow wide well is ALIVE; F is free-energy minimization, and pure minimization freezes you at the bottom, so form-finding must stop SHORT of the minimum to stay at the edge
